title: emergence
content_html:
emergence

In fireworks form and molecule forms, there may be a point at which a larger shape comes into view while its components are still visible. The making of the arrangement and its recognition are two events. How did the larger form come about, and when did it become visible? The Library’s writing on self-organisation makes it possible to ask a further question about how much came from the artist’s decisions and how much arose from the arrangement itself. Emergence — Patterns Without Essence

Reading note. Buddhism. The Kaccānagotta Sutta sets out dependent arising in its account of suffering. The question about conditions has an echo in molecule forms. What relations need to be in place before a shape appears, and what happens to it if one of them changes? Kaccānagotta Sutta, SN 12.15
